title.rendered: Arqaam Capital’s team in Beirut participates in Lebanon Works conference

content.rendered:
Lebanon Works conference is an initiative launched by the Lebanese private sector to drive economic growth through meaningful job creation was attended by +700 people.

Our Arqaam Capital team in Beirut was proud to be a part of the conference and as we continue to grow, we look forward to hiring more talent in Lebanon.

View More
